title: functions.VectorFunctionTask
description: A compiled vector function task ready for execution.

commit.description: Git commit SHA for the function version.

input.description: The resolved input to pass to the function.

output.description:
Expression to transform the task result into a valid function output.

Receives `output` as the nested function's result (Scalar or Vector).
Must return a `TaskOutputOwned` valid for the parent function's type (scalar or vector).
See [`VectorFunctionTaskExpression::output`] for full documentation.

remote.description: The remote source where the function is hosted.
